canonical_external_sources.title: Isolating Cause-Effect Chains from Computer Programs

planned_experiments.name: GOOD_BAD_FIRST_DIVERGENCE
planned_experiments.action: Replay matched GOOD and BAD exact trajectories and identify the earliest state index whose canonical state hash differs under a controlled perturbation or hostile fixture.
planned_experiments.success: A reproducible earliest divergence with primitive-field delta and independent replay receipt.
planned_experiments.falsifier: No stable first divergence across deterministic replays or the compared runs do not share a valid prefix.

planned_experiments.name: VALIDITY_PRESERVING_DDMIN
planned_experiments.action: Minimize the first-divergence delta by perturbing the deterministic transition/generator trace, never by injecting arbitrary invalid proof states.
planned_experiments.success: A smaller replay-valid failure-inducing difference set.
planned_experiments.falsifier: Reduction repeatedly creates invalid states or test count/materialized candidate volume hides exponential work.

planned_experiments.name: BACKWARD_PROOF_SLICE
planned_experiments.action: Where an UNSAT branch can export a standard proof log, backward-trim from contradiction to clauses/lemmas actually needed and compare that slice with the state-delta slice.
planned_experiments.success: Nonempty overlap between independently derived state-delta and proof-dependency slices, with all proof checks passing.
planned_experiments.falsifier: No valid export, replay rejection, or slices remain unrelated.

planned_experiments.name: FRAT_LRAT_INDEPENDENT_REPLAY
planned_experiments.action: Use richer proof provenance/hints and an independently checked LRAT-style view where technically compatible.
planned_experiments.success: Same UNSAT result independently verifies and dependency provenance survives elaboration.
planned_experiments.falsifier: Elaboration cannot preserve the relevant dependencies or verification fails.

planned_experiments.name: UNSAT_CORE_INTERSECTION
planned_experiments.action: Extract non-minimal/trimmed UNSAT cores first; compare repeated core membership across hostile states before attempting expensive minimality.
planned_experiments.success: A stable small clause/reason intersection predicts the bad transition on held-out perturbations.
planned_experiments.falsifier: Core intersection is unstable or equally common on GOOD trajectories.

planned_experiments.name: CONFLICT_CUT_DIAGNOSTIC
planned_experiments.action: Project implication/reason dependencies around a conflict and test UIP/dominator-like cuts as diagnostic graph slices only.
planned_experiments.success: A small cut consistently precedes the first divergence and is replay-verifiable.
planned_experiments.falsifier: Cut depends on arbitrary traversal/order or does not survive replay.

planned_experiments.name: EXACT_TAIL_CAPTURE
planned_experiments.action: Instrument the existing N=43 candidate cells without changing pivot policy; record every T/Smax/Uraw transition, canonical state hash, min-degree pivot data, resource counters and terminal status.
planned_experiments.success: Exact tail receipts for both (43,9,5,28) and (43,9,6,27), including negative/OPEN outcomes.
planned_experiments.falsifier: Instrumentation changes algorithm semantics or fails independent replay.
